<!-- pr-reviewer: c492f7006d0f2397fc7f9afc331521c99ea8210e -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects the stock position and fixture checks.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/fixture_locate.rs:260-265`: Check the actual stock mate geometry after the stock follows the part. Equal bounding boxes do not prove that the stock faces meet the selected fixture faces. A cylindrical stock can pass this check with its selected cap perpendicular to its mate.

   I reproduced this result with a cube part from `[0,0,0]` to `[10,10,10]`. The cylinder has diameter 20, height 20, and position `[5,5,-5]`. Mate its bottom cap to a fixture plane with normal `[1,0,0]`. Use `LocateBody::Stock`, one face mate, and no offset. `LocatePart::new` accepts the quarter turn. After apply, the stock cap normal stays `[0,0,-1]`. Its dot product with the fixture normal is 0; it must be -1. The cylinder stays vertical because the stock follow re-fits it. The desired horizontal cylinder has the same bounding box.

   Refuse this locate, or make the selected stock face meet its mate. Add a regression test for this cylinder. My temporary test failed with this output:

   ```text
   review_cylinder_cap_must_land_on_the_selected_fixture_plane ... FAILED
   accepted locate leaves cap [0.0, 0.0, -1.0] perpendicular to fixture [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]; dot=0
   ```

Local results:

- I trial-merged the head with upstream main `e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8`. The merge was clean. I used no GitHub runner.
- App tests: `fixture_locate` 11 passed; `fixture_locate_stock` 3 passed; `fixture_locate_stock_body` 5 passed; `fixture_plate_followups` 4 passed; `mcp_setup` 9 passed; `mcp_pick` 7 passed; `mcp_lay_face` 1 passed.
- UI library tests, from `crates/ui`: 964 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- Clippy with `-D warnings`: the app library and these seven test targets passed. UI `--all-targets` passed.
- Combined app and UI Clippy with `--all-targets` stopped on existing upstream errors in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107`. The initializer needs `Some(WorkMaterial)` and the `stepdown` and `stepover` fields. Both that file and the type definition match upstream main. These errors are outside this PR.

Mutation checks:

- The PR body lists no mutation runs. I tested two mutations independently in the review worktree.
- Remove the `stock_lands` refusal: `a_stock_that_would_miss_its_mates_is_refused_by_name` failed as expected.
- Remove the stock collision warning: `the_fixture_collision_check_reads_the_located_stock` failed as expected.
- I restored both mutations. All five original stock-body tests then passed. I removed the temporary cylinder test.

Other checks:

- The body has before and after screenshots. I read both form images.
- The PR changes no golden files or snapshot PNGs. There are no moved goldens to inspect.
- The PR adds no dependencies, build scripts, workflows, or process files.
- The default part path, undo, and MCP tests pass.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This PR is a draft again. Reason: the review on head `c492f7006` found a blocker (the stock-mate check compares bounding boxes, thus a cylindrical stock passes with its selected cap perpendicular to the mate plane). A worker fixes it on this branch.

Review fix on head `32102879db06066019ebb066837ce911b7adde0e`. The PR stays a draft with `needs-rework` until a new review.

Finding 1 (`fixture_locate.rs:260-265`, the box compare accepts a cylinder cap perpendicular to its mate):
- `stock_lands` moved to `crates/app/src/fixture_locate_land.rs`. It keeps the box check. Then it judges each picked stock face where the mates put it.
- The followed stock must have facets that face the same way as the picked face (`NORMAL_TOL` = 1e-4 on 1 - cos of the angle, about 0.8 degree) and lie on its plane (`LEN_TOL_MM` = 1e-4 mm).
- These facets must cover the face area (`FACE_AREA_REL_TOL` = 0.1 %) and each facet centre of the face (the footprint).
- A picked stock vertex must be a corner of the followed stock.
- `LocatePart::new` refuses a failure. The message names the stock face and the fixture face, and tells the user to locate without a turn or to locate the part.
- Regression tests in `crates/app/tests/fixture_locate_stock_cylinder.rs`:
  - `a_cylinder_cap_mated_across_its_plane_is_refused`: your repro (D20 x H20 cylinder 5 mm under a 10 mm cube, cap on a +X stop face, one mate, no offset), moved over the vise floor. Refused, and nothing moves.
  - `a_cylinder_cap_mated_on_the_floor_lands_at_the_right_height`: the legal twin. The cap lands at Z 0, the stock stays 20 mm high, the part stays 5 mm above the cap. `fixture_clash::after_fixture_move` reads the landed stock: clear when flush, a warning 2 mm lower.
  - `a_turned_cylinder_cap_on_the_floor_is_judged_by_its_face_and_lands`: a quarter turn re-fits with other facets, so the face check itself must accept it.
- Mutations: `face_lands` always true fails the repro test. `face_lands` always false fails the quarter-turn test.

Local results note (Clippy on `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107`): this PR does not change that file. On the PR base, `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings` is clean. I did not merge `origin/main`.

Tests on `32102879d`: `fixture_locate` 11/11, `fixture_locate_stock` 3/3, `fixture_locate_stock_body` 5/5, `fixture_locate_stock_cylinder` 3/3, `fixture_plate_followups` 4/4, `mcp_setup` 9/9, `mcp_pick` 7/7, `mcp_lay_face` 1/1.
